items.title: Epoch AI compares long-context latency scaling across GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5/Opus 5
items.summary_en: Epoch AI published an analysis of how time-to-first-token scales with context length across models, finding GPT-5.6 shows quadratic growth in latency as context length increases while Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Opus 5 show near-linear growth over the same range.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED); reconstructed from WebSearch snippets referencing this epoch.ai page. Epoch AI's own methodology caveat: small sample (4 models across 2 labs).

items.title: Epoch AI launches 'AI Chip Users' explorer estimating compute capacity by lab
items.summary_en: Epoch AI released a new data explorer estimating AI chip/compute capacity for major labs, including OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and SpaceXAI, based on public disclosures and Epoch's own modeling assumptions.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets. Epoch AI's own caveat: wide uncertainty intervals on compute estimates given reliance on public/partial disclosures.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra tops Epoch Capabilities Index, sets new Math-ECI record, trails on SWE-ECI
items.summary_en: Epoch AI's Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) scored GPT-6 Astra at 166, the highest overall ECI recorded to date, and 170 on the math-specific Math-ECI sub-index, also a new record. However, Epoch found Astra trails Claude Fable 5.1 specifically on the software-engineering SWE-ECI sub-index.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets. An Epoch researcher has publicly cautioned that the ECI is 'a hard to interpret index,' which is included here as a self-stated methodology caveat.

items.title: Epoch AI launches FrontierMath Erdős benchmark of unsolved Erdős problems
items.summary_en: Epoch AI launched a new benchmark, FrontierMath Erdős, consisting of 68 unsolved Erdős problems formalized in the Lean proof assistant. In initial testing, GPT-6 Astra solved 2 of the 68 problems.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets. Publication date inferred from surrounding context rather than directly confirmed on-page.

items.title: Epoch AI trade-data analysis estimates ~$3B in AI chips smuggled to China via Malaysia
items.summary_en: Epoch AI published a trade-data analysis estimating approximately $3 billion worth of AI chips were smuggled into China via Malaysia, as part of a broader estimated range of 290,000 to 1.6 million H100-equivalent chips smuggled into China overall.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets. Epoch AI's own caveat: wide uncertainty interval on the total smuggled-chip estimate (290K-1.6M H100e). Publication date framing inferred from surrounding context.

items.title: Epoch AI finds AI-use acknowledgments in arXiv math preprints rose from 4% to 25% over five months
items.summary_en: Epoch AI's analysis found the share of arXiv math preprints containing an acknowledgment of AI tool use rose from about 4% in April 2026 to about 25% in August 2026.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets. Possible topical overlap noted with an independently authored third-party arXiv preprint covering a similar period; treat as Epoch AI's own independent analysis unless later shown otherwise.

items.title: Epoch AI: cost of a fixed AI performance level has fallen ~47% per quarter since 2023
items.summary_en: In an analysis titled 'The plunging price of thought,' Epoch AI found that across five benchmarks, the cost of achieving a fixed level of AI performance has fallen by roughly 47% per quarter (about 13x per year) since 2023.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets. Based on 5 benchmarks; Epoch AI's own methodology caveat is a limited benchmark sample.

items.title: Epoch AI's Furniture Assembly Benchmark: top score rose 28 points in 10 months, open-weight models lag ~7 months
items.summary_en: Epoch AI's Furniture Assembly Benchmark (FAB) showed the top model score rising from about 52% to 80% (a 28-point increase) over 10 months. Epoch found open-weight models lag proprietary frontier models by roughly 7 months on this benchmark.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets. Epoch AI's own methodology caveat: small sample (60 images / 3 builds).

items.title: Epoch AI updates Huawei-vs-Nvidia AI compute roadmap analysis
items.summary_en: Epoch AI updated its analysis comparing Huawei's and Nvidia's AI compute output, estimating Huawei's 2026 AI compute production remains under 4% of Nvidia's, with the gap persisting through Epoch's projections to 2030.
items.notes: Direct WebFetch to epoch.ai was blocked; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets. Epoch AI's own caveat: forward-looking 2030 projection depends on stated assumptions, including Huawei's memory-chip access.

items.title: Epoch AI updates ECI frontier growth-rate estimate to 14 points/year since reasoning models
items.summary_en: Epoch AI updated its estimate of the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) frontier growth rate to roughly 14 points per year, measured since the introduction of reasoning models.
